profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Bloomberg LP |  Ex-Citi | Mentor at upGrad | DSA enthusiast | Writer at theengineeringmind.substack.com
profile.summary:
Substack: https://substack.com/@kinjalpatel63
The Engineering Mind: https://theengineeringmind.substack.com
Medium: https://medium.com/@kinjalpatel63

Senior Software Engineer at Bloomberg, where I design and develop high-performance financial applications that power critical trading, data processing, and real-time systems for the global markets.
Passionate about leveraging cutting-edge technologies—including emerging AI tools—to deliver faster, more efficient, and innovative solutions in fast-paced environments.
Explore my thoughts on engineering, system design, and the intersection of finance and technology:

Core Expertise:

Backend: Java, C++, Redis, Spring, ElasticSearch, Apache Kafka, SQL databases
Frontend: React.js, Micro Frontends, JavaScript, TypeScript
API Gateway & Security: Extensive experience with IBM API Connect, optimizing for high concurrency, performance tuning, SSL termination, OAuth, JWT, and advanced application-level security
Payments: Deep expertise in implementing secure, scalable, and compliant payment API best practices

Proven in building robust, low-latency systems that handle massive concurrent loads while maintaining reliability and security—skills honed through real-world financial infrastructure challenges.
Always exploring AI-driven development workflows to accelerate delivery without compromising quality.

Let’s connect if you’re working on complex financial systems, scalable architectures, or the future of AI in engineering!

positions.title: Sr. Software Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
- API gateway development with OAuth and authentication on middle-tier
- development of business APIs using Java, Kafka Stream processing, Oracle and Elastic Search.
- Responsible for architecting and providing solutions in payment domain
- Engaged in securing the APIs using appropriate encryption-decryption algorithms

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Involved in end-to-end product development using latest technology stack. Responsible for full-stack development using Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate as back-end tech stack and AngularJS, Javascript, HTML5 as front-end technologies.
Well versed with DevOps using Jenkins, Docker. 
Exposure in IPFS, Ethereum Blockchain, Solidity.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop Android Applications with core Android APIs and hands-on experience with NDK as well.
- Developed Java EE web application using Spring and Hibernate framework
- Designed and prepared a working model of IoT for mobile devices using Raspberry Pi and Arduino
- Experienced in all phases of software life cycle like analysis, designing, developing, testing,    installing, configuring and maintaining applications.
- Experience in working on Agile Methodologies.
- Excellent hands-on experience dealing with the offshore model.
- Effective result oriented team player with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Varaha Systems is a FMC market leader, 
Role & Responsibility:
- FMC/VoIP client for various platform on Android.
- Exposure to design & develop SIP stack for Android OS.
- Exposure to work with RFCs 3261, 3265.
- Interop with different call managers. ( SIPx, Asterisk )

honors.title: Runner Up
honors.description:
A Hackathon was planned at Solution Analysts to explore employee technical skills and innovation.
Me and my team had completed successful Augmented Reality based project in 24 hour with continuos integration. All latest tools like Asana for Project management, APIdoc to prepare API documentation, AR SDK, etc.

projects.title: Media Platform
projects.description: Media Platform aims to allow advertisers to run highly-targeted mobile ad campaigns and enables publishers to monetize their apps and mobile sites via advertising. This platform essentially buys traffic, connecting advertisers with the space they need in the process.

projects.title: Brabble
projects.description:
Brabble is a social sharing app that allows sharing of video, photo, audio and text all in one network 
in which users can reply or comment back.User can also share post to facebook and twitter & chose his own privacy settings.
